# Avatar

An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

- **Import:** `import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-avatar--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarImage,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function AvatarExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarImage src="https://github.com/shadcn.png" alt="@shadcn" />
        <AvatarFallback>CN</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Avatar

It forwards its ref to `HTMLSpanElement`. Its props are `Omit<AvatarPrimitive.AvatarProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## AvatarImage

It forwards its ref to `HTMLImageElement`. Its props are `Omit<AvatarPrimitive.AvatarImageProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLImageElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `onLoadingStatusChange`: `(status: ImageLoadingStatus) => void`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## AvatarFallback

It forwards its ref to `HTMLSpanElement`. Its props are `Omit<AvatarPrimitive.AvatarFallbackProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `delayMs`: `number`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
